svg.title: Derived — where a corrector beats leaving the calibration alone
svg.desc: Scene mean of per-frame median reprojection shift (pixel P50) against each single-axis fault on 30 locked nuScenes validation scenes. Lower is better. Squares show the paired 95% interval of identity versus the fixed-three-seed learned mean; intervals are pointwise.
svg.text: Derived — where a corrector beats leaving the calibration alone
Pixel P50: scene mean of the per-frame median reprojection shift, 30 locked nuScenes validation scenes. Lower is better.
Axes are CAM_FRONT optical-frame axes: roll = tilt, pitch = pan, yaw = in-plane rotation; x lateral, y vertical, z forward.
Squares: identity → learned-mean paired 95% interval above 0 (green, learned better), below 0 (red) or containing 0 (white).
Dashed lines: break-even, the smallest fault from which the learned mean is better at both signs. The mean is not an ensemble.

g.text: fault (m) · no break-even up to ±0.2 m

svg.text: Derived by bevcalib.analysis.operating_envelope from the v1.0.0 metrics.json and intervals.json. Not detector or vehicle safety evidence.
